messages:
marta: quick question — our int4 variant for rwd-v2p2 looks fine in shadow, but we keep seeing a tiny bump in p95 for long-docs when cold kv cache hits. thinking about adding a lightweight 'kv warmup' phase in canary before traffic ramp. thoughts?
aj: can you quantify 'tiny'? what numbers are we seeing vs baseline? :chart_with_upwards_trend:
marta: on a 10k sample long-doc slice p95 latency +48ms and tail token-generation ratio drops by ~0.6%. quality (rr@10) is flat. the weirdness shows up only on new sessions where kv isn't populated.
kevin: +48ms is within SLO but it's consistent. my worry is user-facing regressions when promote -> full. warmup phase sounds right: prefill KV with typical prefixes from shadow, then ramp. how long to warmup?
ciara: we tried prefill with top-100 prefixes in staging before; it reduced the delta to ~+10ms but added an extra preflight cost. suggestion: short warmup (1k sample traffic) + soft-canary (1%) for 30m, then measure. automation could promote if metrics pass.
marta: propose specific promote criteria: p95 latency delta <= +50ms, top-level hallucination delta <= +0.5%, rerank MAE <= 1.0, and longdoc tail token drop <= 1%. plus no systemic error spikes. if any fail, auto-fallback.
aj: that's reasonable. add an explicit warmup success metric: kv-hit-rate on longdoc slice >= 70% after warmup window, else keep shadow for another cycle.
kevin: also track burst p99 CPU on GPU host — quant variant sometimes has jitter under certain batching. require p99 CPU delta <= +10% or abort.
ciara: small nit: hallucination delta is noisy on low-volume slices. use bootstrap CI or require the delta to persist for 3 consecutive 10m windows before tripping auto-fallback.
rollout-bot: rollout plan recorded: {"variant":"rwd-v2p2-int4","warmup_traffic":1000,"soft_canary_pct":1,"soft_canary_window":"30m","promote_criteria":"p95<=+50ms,halluc_delta<=0.5%,rerank_MAE<=1.0,kv_hit_rate>=70%,p99_cpu<=+10%","auto_fallback":true} (use /rollout show to edit)
marta: thanks — i'll draft the playbook with runbook steps for ops and include the bootstrap requirement on hallucination. we'll run a staging warmup tomorrow morning. ciara can you queue the prefill job?
ciara: queued. job id `warmup-2026-03-22-01`. will post smoke snapshot when done. :white_check_mark:
aj: please also enable quiet-shadow for 10% traffic for the first hour after promote to capture longtail behaviour without affecting most users.
kevin: noted. i'll add p99 GPU memory and oom counters to the smoke dashboard.
marta: perfect. if smoke looks good i'll kick auto-promote with the thresholds above. thanks team! :rocket:
